title: Lei n.º 2/91/M, Lei de bases do ambiente (Environmental framework law), as republished by Lei n.º 26/2024
citation: Lei n.º 2/91/M of 11 March 1991 (BO 10/1991), republished with adaptation and integration by Lei n.º 26/2024 (BO 1/2025, published 2025-01-06)
evidence: The Boletim Oficial page prints "Publicado em: 1991.3.11" and the notice "O conteúdo deste diploma legal foi republicado pela Lei n.º 26/2024"; it states no commencement date for the 1991 text. Lei n.º 26/2024 Entrada em vigor: "A presente lei entra em vigor no dia seguinte ao da sua publicação." (published 2025-01-06, so the republished text is in force from 2025-01-07). Opened https://bo.dsaj.gov.mo/bo/i/91/10/lei02.asp and https://bo.dsaj.gov.mo/bo/i/2025/01/lei26.asp on 2026-11-10.
notes: General environmental framework (principles, Chief Executive duties, priorities of air, water, habitat); no climate, emissions-reporting or carbon-price duty seen. in_force is null because no official page states the 1991 commencement; the record is dated 2025-01-07, the day the republished text took effect. The Boletim Oficial serves only the republished text on this page; the as-made 1991 text exists only as a scanned PDF (https://images.bo.dsaj.gov.mo//bo/i/91/10/lei-2-91.pdf) and is not stored. Languages stored on 2026-11-10: pt, zh (the two official languages, same page names with _cn). Government English: not found; looked for on the Boletim Oficial diploma page (links only to the Chinese version) and in the Boletim Oficial legislation index.

title: Lei n.º 9/2021, Lei de protecção dos direitos e interesses do consumidor (Consumer protection law)
evidence: Article "Entrada em vigor e produção de efeitos", n.º 1: "A presente lei entra em vigor no dia 1 de Janeiro de 2022." Opened https://bo.dsaj.gov.mo/bo/i/2021/28/lei09.asp on 2026-11-10.
notes: Narrower than its family: arts 26 and 27 prohibit unfair and misleading commercial practices in general terms, and a search of the Portuguese text for "ambient" found no environmental wording, so it is a general misleading-conduct law with no environmental-claims provision. The page lists no amending law. n.º 2 of the same article delays the effect of al. 2) of n.º 1 of the preceding article (the repeal provision) until the new organic law of the Consumer Council comes into force; the record is the whole law. Languages stored on 2026-11-10: pt, zh. Government English: not found; looked for on the Boletim Oficial diploma page (Chinese version link only).
